entries.t: The diary form
entries.n: A narrative built from dated entries written close to the events, so that the teller has no hindsight, no chance to shape the story and no way of leaving anything out that he has not yet learnt to be ashamed of.
entries.s: the diary form

entries.t: The unreliable narrator
entries.n: A narrator whose account the reader learns to read against, because he misjudges himself or the meaning of what he reports.
entries.s: the unreliable narrator

entries.t: Style
entries.n: A speech habit belonging to one character alone, so that they can be recognised before they are named.
entries.s: style
